goal: Allow subtree backports to reuse merge commits verbatim on release branches
Eliminates redundant re-review by verifying subtree updates stack on previous subtree merges
agreement: Unaddressed objection: adds bash maintenance overhead for a mere style preference (maflcko)
Nonblocking objection: default check breaks for users who only want to verify subtree integrity (sedited)
Support because it documents good backporting practice and saves reviewer effort (ryanofsky)
Verified by testing that the backportability check passes and fails as expected (BrandonOdiwuor)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it adds repository hygiene linting rather than fixing test reliability or consensus code
Saves reviewer effort during subtree backports by catching unstackable merges early
